# Menu music

Credit supplied for this file: Universe - Space Sounds by JuliusH, Pixabay Content License.

Source: https://pixabay.com/music/ambient-universe-space-sounds-3595/

The supplied `Ambient Music.ogg` was renamed to `Universe-Space-Sounds.ogg`. Its audio is unchanged. It is 25:13 long; the linked track is 1:41.

The menu streams the file, fades it in, and loops it.
